verdict.rationale: SendGrid's Event Webhook posts email event data to a URL you control, and the Inbound Parse webhook forwards parsed incoming mail to your endpoint. Together they let you trigger your own actions on events, but the rule logic has to live in external code. There is no evidence of an in-product rules or automation builder; Marketing Campaigns appears only as a page title. Missing for 10: native rule or condition definition, built-in automated actions (e.g., workflow or automation sequences), event filtering configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
